## Change

Describe the problem, affected clauses/profile versions and compatibility.

## Evidence

List commands and actual results, including failures and unsupported scope.
For semantic changes, include the synthetic counterexample and expected result.

## Contribution Check

- [ ] I am authorized to contribute the original material in this PR under this repository's MIT license.
- [ ] I have identified third-party sources/notices and relevant affiliations or conflicts.
- [ ] I have not included credentials, customer data or protected evaluation material.
- [ ] I have not silently changed a frozen source, expected result or historical report.
